changes: Added conversation/message-scoped local event versions. Each WS create/update observes its version before async cache/decrypt work; later events invalidate earlier work and its cache-write guard. Delete observations retain tombstones until the composer/account generation changes; delayed create/update cannot reuse a deleted ID.

All DM history paths capture their version boundary before requesting history and pass a per-message freshness guard through actual decryption/cache operations. Messages superseded while awaiting cache/decryption are omitted without dropping unaffected messages. Final history publication filters stale/deleted versions too.

Tail history preserves newer loaded live messages instead of replacing them with older response data. Around-message windows preserve newer loaded versions for IDs in that window and reject a target deleted during loading. Equal-timestamp response ordering is retained. This is local observation order, not a server revision, delivery guarantee or authentication mechanism.
verification: Focused suites passed before the last history-decrypt test: 4 files / 107 tests. Additional real batch-decrypt regression passed in the 40-test crypto suite. Covers deferred create/delete, reversed asynchronous edit completion, deleted history exclusion, live edit preservation, original conversation identities and generation reset.

Full client suite passed: 232 files / 2281 tests in 47.55s; Vite build passed in 698ms with existing warnings. A subsequent type-only test annotation corrected a tsc diagnostic without changing runtime code. Final tsc -b, targeted ESLint and re-run affected crypto/version suites passed: 2 files / 43 tests. Targeted diff whitespace and coverage validation passed; acceptance remains incomplete.
remaining: Late HTTP send/edit cache writes are not yet arbitrated against these WS observations. Cross-tab cache transactions and persisted server revision ordering remain open.

Live creates/edits arriving before any history window is loaded can still need explicit recovery/refetch if the existing WS slice has no loaded record to preserve. Pagination conservatively rejects replaced window identities. Browser and two-client acceptance remain required.

Event-version retention is session-scoped; long-session memory/performance and reconnect reconciliation require further testing. Overall P0-P11 remains incomplete; no GitHub or production release operation performed.
